ITEM 1 | Grain side dish: small tan-brown granules with a fine, slightly fluffy texture, scattered with flecks of orange and green bits, dry-looking with light sheen, mounded in a loose heap covering roughly 20% of the plate's left-center area, about 6 cm tall at the mound peak | 150
ITEM 2 | Leafy green salad: dark and light green curly leaves with thin shredded orange carrot strips, sliced pale-pink radish rounds, and small white crumbles, sitting in a mound on the upper right, covering about 20% of the plate, about 3 cm tall, slightly glossy with dressing | 80
ITEM 3 | Red sauced item: a flat, soft-looking piece with a bright red tomato-like sauce coating, golden-brown edges, a pale cream-colored wedge on top and small green herb sprigs, sitting on the left edge of the plate, about 8 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm thick, moist and glossy | 110
ITEM 4 | Roasted eggplant: cubes about 2 to 3 cm per side with dark purple skin and cream interior, showing browned, charred grill marks and slightly glossy oil sheen, scattered in a cluster in the lower right of the plate, about 2 cm tall | 90
ITEM 5 | Corn: a round cross-section of cooked yellow corn about 5 cm across and 3 cm thick, bright yellow kernels with a slightly moist sheen, sitting at the bottom-left of the plate beside the eggplant | 60
